intro.heading: Prove your German level
intro.lead: A complete exam at your level: reading, listening, reading aloud, writing and a camera oral. Your result is published automatically. The AMUD team can correct it when needed.
intro.levelFromCertificate: You are taking the {level} exam: the level on your certificate.
intro.levelFromDeclared: You are taking the {level} exam: the level you declared.
intro.chooseLevelHint: Your profile has no German level yet. Choose the one you believe you have.
intro.phaseTwoNote: Phase 2: a speaking test on camera, with a situation revealed at the last moment.
intro.rules: Each section is timed and cannot be reopened. Do not switch tabs or paste text: these events are reported to the instructor.
intro.consent: I agree that my answers and my audio and video recordings are kept and analysed (including by AI) to assess my level, then reviewed by the AMUD team.
intro.unavailable: The exam for this level is not available yet. Please come back soon.
intro.cooldown: You can take the exam again from {date}.
intro.noLevels: No exam is available at the moment.

sectionIntro.heading: Section {n}/4 — {name}
sectionIntro.reading: Read the texts and answer the questions. You can move freely between the questions of this section.
sectionIntro.listening: Listen to the recordings and answer. Each recording can only be played a limited number of times.
sectionIntro.read_aloud: A text will appear. Read it aloud, clearly, in one take. Allow the microphone when your browser asks.
sectionIntro.writing: Write your answers directly in the fields. Copy and paste are disabled.

runner.finishConfirm: Finish this section? You will not be able to change your answers.
runner.pasteBlocked: Pasting is disabled during the exam.
runner.micDenied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser and try again.
runner.timeUp: Time is up: the section was closed with your saved answers.
runner.saveFailed: Some answers have not been saved. Check your connection and retry before finishing.

scoring.heading: Marking in progress…
scoring.body: Your written answers and your reading are being assessed. This usually takes one or two minutes.

result.heading: Phase 1 complete
result.mayBeHigher: Level {level} confirmed — you could aim higher
result.provisionalNote: The final level requires passing reading, listening, writing and speaking at the exam level.
result.phaseTwoBody: The speaking test will be available here soon. You will be notified as soon as it opens.
result.awaitingReview: For B2 exams and above, the AMUD team checks every result before publishing it. You will be notified as soon as it is available.
result.validatedHeading: Level established by the AMUD exam
result.finalNote: Your result is available on your profile and visible to recruiters. The AMUD team can correct it when needed.
result.failedBody: Part of your exam could not be graded. No incomplete level has been published. You can try again.
result.annulledBody: The AMUD team cancelled this exam. Its result is no longer used on your profile.
result.notDemonstratedNote: No lower level has been awarded. Take the corresponding exam to establish another level.
result.phaseOneComplete: Phase 1 is complete; speaking still needs to be assessed.
result.readAloudDiagnostic: Read-aloud: {score}% for text matching and estimated clarity. This feedback does not determine the CEFR level.

errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection.

oral.introBody: You will answer {n} situations out loud (level {level}). Each situation appears at an unexpected moment once the camera is on. You get {prep} seconds to prepare, then recording starts by itself.
checklist: A quiet place, with nobody else
Your face clearly visible and lit
No notes and no outside help
oral.start: Turn on the camera and start
oral.cameraDenied: The camera or microphone is blocked. Allow them in your browser and try again.
oral.waiting: Stay in front of the camera: the situation is about to appear…
oral.expired: Time for this situation is over.
oral.uploadFailed: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
